summary: Frontend testing of SB Market P1 enhancements: unified inbox + advanced filters. Logged in as famtester@demo.sb (mobile 430px), exercised the inbox flow end-to-end and all advanced filter behaviours on /sb-market. Every requested data-testid is present and every behaviour matches the spec.
critical_code_review_comments: SbMarketHub.js is ~480 lines and contains hub + categories + advanced filters + publish sheet + location sheet. Could be split for maintainability (extract BottomSheet, AdvancedFiltersSheet, PublishSheet into their own files), but no correctness issue.

Inbox WebSocket repeatedly logs 'WebSocket is closed before the connection is established' on first render of /sb-market and /sb-market/messages — non-blocking (REST poll fallback covers it) but noisy in console. Pre-existing in useWebSocket; not introduced by this P1.
advCount logic counts sort!=='recent' as 1 criterion — correct per spec; just noting that a user opening the sheet and selecting the same default still won't bump the badge (good).
seed_data_creation: Sent one test message 'Test inbox iter383' in the first real-estate thread (Paul Vendeur / Appartement T3 lumineux TEST MODIFIÉ).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Inbox now shows 4 threads for famtester (not 3): 2 real-estate + Canapé cuir marketplace + a 4th 'Canapé cuir' thread tagged 'Nouvelle conversation' — appears to be a previously seeded/empty thread from earlier iterations, not a bug. Unread badge logic verified by code (sum of thread.unread) but element absent at runtime because all unread counts are 0 — per agent-note this is expected and NOT a bug.
